headline: Vietnam seeks experience from FMA in completing the crypto-asset supervision mechanism
summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Finance and State Securities Commission discussed crypto-asset management with Austria's financial markets regulator. Vietnam expects to complete its pilot and licensing framework in 2026.
why: Crypto-asset rules set licensing, custody and disclosure standards that determine which firms can operate and how investors are protected in a market.
